cs.t: I had a razer mouse and headphones, which from time to time crashed their driver server or whatever and nothing could help until the cold restart of the PC and a laptop. Razer. Never again.

cs.t: The last one I remember is plugging a Razer mouse  Oh, yeah.  Bought this overpriced but heavily hyped Razer mouse and it wouldn't even work right until it had an internet connection.  A MOUSE.  I'd never encountered something so blatantly customer hostile in my life.  Never even looked at another Razer product, never will, and will tell anyone who will listen that Razer is a terrible company full of objectively terrible people.
